summaryZh: Moiseenko 页面研究放疗的正常组织并发症预测、功能成像优化和肿瘤及正常组织反应。研究方法涉及结局数据统计分析、机制建模和蒙特卡洛模拟。

evidence.quote: Dr. Moiseenko’s research interests include outcomes data analysis, functional imaging, Monte Carlo simulations, propagation of uncertainties associated with radiation therapy and modeling of tumor and normal tissue response to radiation.
